definitions.full: H1444. geder גָּדֵר noun masculine Ezek 42:7 wall (Late Hebrew גָּדֵר , Aramaic גְּדֵירָא גָּדֵירָא, , Arabic , , and more commonly enclosing-wall compare Hebrew גְּדוֺר below) — absolute גָּדֵר Num 22:24 ; 24:24 5 t. + Psa 62:4 (read גדרה compare below) + Ezek 13:5 (Co גדרת compare below); construct גָּדֶר Prov 24:31 ; Ezek 42:10 (Co strike out); suffix גְּדֵרוֺ Isa 5:5 , גְּדֵרָהּ Hosea 2:8 (compare Baer, note); plural suffix גְּדֵרַיִךְ Micah 7:11 , גְּדֵרֶיהָ Psa 80:13 ; — wall, fence , bordering a road Num 2:24 (twice in verse) compare Eccl 10:8 ; connected with Ezekiel's temple Ezek 42:7 ; city wall Micah 7:11 compare Ezra 9:9 ; figurative of Yahweh's vineyard Isa 5:5 ; Psa 80:13 ; of fortunes of Israel Ezek 22:30 ; so also 13:5 (Co גְּדֶרֶת compare גְּדֵרָה ); of hindrance in path of Israel (figurative as woman) Hosea 2:8 ; of man beset by enemies Psa 62:4 ( הַדְּחוּיָה ׳ג , but read ד ׳גְּדֵרָה Ol De etc.)
